title: Prepare only dossiers with missing drafts
intro: Review upcoming social passages needing preparation. Existing drafts, including your edits, are preserved.
unavailable: Selection unavailable. Refresh before starting; an empty dossier list is not inferred.
limits: Maximum 20 dossiers per batch; counts cover upcoming open Facebook/LinkedIn passages, not all services.
empty: No dossier needs preparation in this observation.
safety: Starting opens the batch with its usual confirmations. This preview is advisory: sources are checked again at startup and each dossier before processing. Existing drafts are never replaced; no approval, media selection or publication is created.
measurement: Preserved drafts avoid another creation but do not prove minutes saved. Human time and avoided corrections still need measurement on comparable cases.
more: More dossiers need preparation. Read a fresh selection after completing this batch.
